insight: Freedom begins with honesty. Confession brings light.
reflection: Where can you be honest with yourself and God this week?
look_back: What was one victory and one challenge you experienced over the past week?
look_into_question: What parts of your struggle feel hardest to put into words?
look_up_questions: What does Psalm 51 reveal about God's willingness to restore us?
How can honesty bring light into areas of shame?
prayer: Lord, give me the courage to step into the light of honesty today. Amen.

insight: There is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
reflection: How can you receive God's grace for your struggle?
look_back: Did you notice any moments of guilt this week? How did you respond to them?
look_into_question: What is the difference between conviction that heals and condemnation that hurts?
look_up_questions: How does knowing you are not condemned change your perspective on healing?
Where do you need to extend grace to yourself?
prayer: Father, help me rest in Your grace and release the burden of self-condemnation. Amen.

insight: Healing grows in fellowship when we walk together.
reflection: Who can you lean on this week?
look_back: Did you isolate yourself at any point this week, or did you reach out?
look_into_question: Why is vulnerability with trusted brothers or sisters so essential for recovery?
look_up_questions: What prevents us from seeking accountability?
How does mutual prayer strengthen us?
prayer: Lord, build surrounding strength in my life. Help me be vulnerable with trusted support. Amen.

insight: God is faithful; He will provide a way out so you can endure.
reflection: What triggers do you face, and what healthy responses can you practice?
look_back: What situations, emotions, or environments tested your resolve this week?
look_into_question: Can you identify the early warning signs before a trigger becomes an action?
look_up_questions: What 'way out' has God already placed in your daily routine?
How can you pause before reacting?
prayer: God, grant me discernment to recognize triggers early and wisdom to take the escape route You provide. Amen.

insight: Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name; you are mine.
reflection: Who or what needs your forgiveness? How will you accept God's forgiveness yourself?
look_back: In what ways did resentment or old wounds weigh on your heart this week?
look_into_question: How does holding onto past hurts affect your freedom today?
look_up_questions: What does it mean to be called by name by God?
How does forgiveness open the door to true self-worth?
prayer: Father, thank You for redeeming me. Give me grace to forgive others and accept Your unconditional love. Amen.

insight: Clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.
reflection: What step can you take to restore or strengthen a relationship?
look_back: How did your interactions with family, friends, or group members feel this week?
look_into_question: What practical steps can you take to rebuild trust where it was strained?
look_up_questions: How does practicing patience transform daily relationships?
Which virtue in Colossians 3:12 do you need most this week?
prayer: Lord, teach me patience and humility as I work to restore peace and trust in my relationships. Amen.

insight: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then.
reflection: What does freedom in Christ look like in your daily choices?
look_back: Where did you experience a moment of breakthrough or clarity this week?
look_into_question: What habits or routines help guard the freedom you are building?
look_up_questions: What does standing firm require when old temptations return?
How can you celebrate progress without letting your guard down?
prayer: Jesus, thank You for setting me free. Help me stand firm every single day. Amen.

insight: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead, I press on.
reflection: What keeps you motivated to keep moving forward in your journey?
look_back: Reflecting on the 8 weeks, what is the single biggest change in how you approach your struggle?
look_into_question: How will you maintain your momentum beyond this cycle?
look_up_questions: What promise of God will anchor you in the weeks ahead?
How can you help someone else walking a similar path?
prayer: Lord, thank You for bringing me through. Keep my eyes fixed on You as I press forward in strength. Amen.
